thread:
elaine (CEO): quick weekly dispatch — thank you all for the push this week. a few concise asks and updates for the org: 1) launch hold policy  any Dedicated region go-live requires p99 verification + cost delta sign-off (product + finance) before marketing opens outbound; 2) metrics: target short-term p99 improvement of 10% for hosted API and a 6% unit-cost reduction pilot; 3) incident hygiene: all incidents with customer impact >10m need a one-page RCA and a 2-week mitigation plan. details below.

sam (VP Eng): noted. eng will run a two-day latency blitz focused on batching heuristics and KV cache warmup. will post a short plan by EOD Monday.

maria (VP Product): product will enforce the launch hold checklist. canary must hit p95/p99 gates and cost band before we flip traffic. will share the checklist in #release-war-room tomorrow.

jordan (CFO): finance: pre-approve up to $50k burst buffer for one month per new region, but any spend above needs documented ROI. marketing spend remains paused until sign-off.

infra-bot: incident summary 1999987654  routing reconciliation bug caused ~15m degraded throughput for embeddings in us-east. automatic fallback kept most traffic healthy. root cause: reconciliation loop raced with config apply. mitigation: revert + add reconciliation lock. link: https://internal.redwood/incident/1999987654

sam (VP Eng): quick patch merged to add a global lock during routing reconcile: ```diff
- reconcileRoutes()
+ withLock(reconcileRoutes)
```

elaine (CEO): two asks from me: 1) incidents channel gets the one-page RCA by tomorrow noon, 2) eng-infra adds a pre-deploy linter that rejects reconcile runs without the lock.

ana (Head of GTM): (typo note) ana here — sales and partnerships will pause region outreach until product/finance sign-off. we'll prep collateral and a soft-launch playbook to use once we get green lights.

jordan (CFO): also request a weekly cost dashboard snapshot for execs (tokens, egress, reserved capacity). small weekly email is fine.

maria (VP Product): fallback variants for next launches: "redwood-lite-q6" then "redwood-core-dense". i'll add them to the canary config.

sam (VP Eng): publishing a perf runbook and a cost-play short doc by next Monday. will include measurable gates.

elaine (CEO): appreciate the focus. hiring ask: two senior infra hires (kernel optimization + autoscale) — please push referrals. short exec sync Friday 9am PT to review p99 numbers and go/no-go checklist. thanks team. :rocket:
